_ghi_chu: Chep tep nay thanh cap-nhat.json (khong dau '.example') roi sua theo may.
cap-nhat.json KHONG len kho (.gitignore) - moi may tu cau hinh rieng.
kho: 'owner/repo' tren GitHub. De trong '' = KHONG cap nhat gi (an toan mac dinh).
nhanh: nhanh Git doc manifest/tep, mac dinh 'main'.
kenh: 'on-dinh' hoac 'thu' - chon manifest phat-hanh/<kenh>/manifest.json nao.
chinh_sach: 'hoi' (chi bao co ban moi, khong tu ap) | 'khung_an_toan' (duoc tu ap, nhung chi khi core.an_toan_khoi_dong.kiem_tra() dong y) | 'tat' (khong bao gio tu ap, ke ca khi duoc hoi).
Doc them: core/nguon_cap_nhat.py (module doc tep nay).
dong_bo_git: may cai tu git clone (co .git) cap nhat qua core/dong_bo_git.py, KHONG qua manifest. Khi tu_keo=true thi duong manifest tu nhuong.
dong_bo_git.tu_keo: true = lich ShopAPI-DongBoGit duoc tu keo ban moi (gio vang 'gio'); false = lich co chay cung thoat ngay.
dong_bo_git.ma_may: ten ngan cua may (vd 'vps-jp1'), dung dat ten tep chia-se/bai-hoc/<ma_may>-<ngach>.json.
